title: Nothing you can see changed: rear wings can take slate roofs
items: Nothing you can see changed yet. The kit the Prairie Avenue houses are built from can now roof a rear wing with a slated hip or gable, where every wing was decked flat in tin.
Where a wing rises past the house it stands against, the join is closed in the wing's own walling.
It is the piece 1801 Prairie, the Kimball house, needs for its gabled section and its east range.
